Introduction

April was a South Korean girl group formed by DSP Media in 2015. They debuted on August 24, 2015, with the mini-album Dreaming. The group originally included Somin, who left shortly after debut due to discomfort with the group’s concept and later joined KARD.

Member Hyunjoo took a break due to health issues in 2016. She later left with the reasoning of pursuing acting. Chaekyung and Rachel were added to the group afterward, forming the final six-member lineup: Chaekyung, Chaewon, Naeun, Yena, Rachel, and Jinsol.

Years later, in 2021, Hyunjoo’s brother alleged that she had been bullied by the other members, leading to her departure and even a suicide attempt. Hyunjoo later confirmed the claims, while DSP Media denied them and announced legal action. The controversy led to public backlash against the group.

On January 28, 2022, DSP Media announced April’s disbandment after six years, following extended discussions.
